automation.fail_safe: Exclusive locks; partial failure preserves the previous valid deployment artifact.

text.zh: 每条经验同时保存支持条件、最小反例和弃权区域。
text.en: Store support conditions, minimal counterexamples, and abstention regions with every lesson.

text.zh: 带边界经验应保持正迁移，同时减少跨任务错误调用。
text.en: Bounded lessons should preserve positive transfer while reducing erroneous cross-task invocation.

text.zh: 自然语言经验被过度泛化到表面相似但约束不同的状态。
text.en: Natural-language lessons are overgeneralized to superficially similar states with different constraints.

text.zh: 学习一个小型元控制器，根据边际收益、分歧、回退和成本选择继续、回滚或停止。
text.en: Learn a small meta-controller that chooses continue, roll back, or stop from marginal gain, disagreement, regression, and cost.

text.zh: 控制器应在等效性能下减少至少 30% 调用，并能跨任务族迁移。
text.en: The controller should save at least 30% of calls at matched utility and transfer across task families.

text.zh: 固定反思和更新轮数会在简单任务浪费调用，在困难任务过早停止。
text.en: Fixed evolution rounds waste calls on easy tasks and stop too early on difficult ones.

text.zh: 候选经验必须在 matched replay 中改变目标失败，并对无关变化保持稳定，才允许持久写入。
text.en: A candidate lesson must change the target failure in matched replay and remain stable to irrelevant changes before persistent admission.

text.zh: 因果准入应提高未来任务收益并降低有害 commit。
text.en: Causal admission should improve future-task utility and reduce harmful commits.

text.zh: 成功轨迹常产生非因果或不可复用经验，按成功率写入会积累有害规则。
text.en: Successful trajectories often yield non-causal or non-reusable lessons, making success-only admission harmful.

text.zh: 通过顺序交换和局部组合实验学习更新之间的非交换性与交互图。
text.en: Learn non-commutativity and an interaction graph through order swaps and local composition tests.

text.zh: 交互图应预测未见组合回退并找到更优提交顺序。
text.en: The interaction graph should predict unseen composition regressions and identify better commit orders.

text.zh: 两个单独有效的更新组合后可能相互干扰，逐项回归无法预测组合效果。
text.en: Two individually useful updates can interfere when composed; individual regression tests cannot predict composition.

text.zh: 固定容量下联合优化代表性和反证保留，保存能改变结论的最小反例集。
text.en: Under fixed capacity, optimize representativeness and counterevidence retention, preserving a minimal conclusion-changing set.

text.zh: 保留反证应减少过度概括和后续负迁移。
text.en: Preserving counterevidence should reduce overgeneralization and later negative transfer.

text.zh: 记忆压缩倾向保留共识摘要，丢掉能推翻规则的少数反证。
text.en: Memory consolidation preserves consensus summaries and drops rare counterevidence that can overturn a rule.

text.zh: 对检查、重采样、工具调用和局部重写做局部反事实信用分配。
text.en: Assign local counterfactual credit to checking, resampling, tool use, and local rewrite actions.

text.zh: 动作级信用应减少无效纠正调用而保持修复率。
text.en: Action-level credit should remove ineffective correction calls while preserving repair.

text.zh: 多轮纠正中无法判断哪次 critique 或修复动作真正带来提升。
text.en: Multi-round correction does not reveal which critique or repair action caused improvement.

text.zh: 从隐含规则生成单约束变化的边界任务，只保留能触发一致性破坏且可自动验证的反例。
text.en: Generate single-constraint boundary tasks from implicit rules and retain only automatically verifiable counterexamples.

text.zh: 最小反例应提高规则边界泛化，而不只是近邻任务性能。
text.en: Minimal counterexamples should improve boundary generalization rather than nearby-task performance only.

text.zh: 课程生成模仿失败样本，却不主动寻找能推翻当前策略规则的最小反例。
text.en: Curriculum generation imitates failures rather than searching for minimal counterexamples to current policy rules.

text.zh: 用固定锚点和行为分布距离监测漂移，并触发 replay、减小更新或停止。
text.en: Monitor drift with frozen anchors and behavioral distance, triggering replay, smaller updates, or stopping.

text.zh: 漂移信号应在锚点退化前预测回退。
text.en: Drift signals should predict regression before anchor degradation.

text.zh: 在线课程改变策略分布，旧 Reward 和任务生成器随迭代失配。
text.en: Online curricula shift policy distributions, making rewards and task generators stale.

text.zh: 每轮交叉配对 Actor/Reward 版本，并用冻结锚点和异构 Judge 阻止只对当前 Actor 有利的更新。
text.en: Cross-pair actor and reward versions each round and use frozen anchors plus heterogeneous judges to block actor-specific evaluator updates.

text.zh: 跨版本门控应降低外部 Judge 和人工小样本上的 reward hacking。
text.en: Cross-version gating should reduce reward hacking under external judges and small human audits.

text.zh: Actor 与评价器同时进化会共同放大捷径，内部 reward 上升但外部质量下降。
text.en: Co-evolving actors and evaluators can amplify shared shortcuts while external quality declines.

text.zh: 只保留位于当前成功—失败边界附近且能区分相邻 checkpoint 的任务。
text.en: Keep only tasks near the success-failure boundary that discriminate adjacent checkpoints.

text.zh: 前沿任务应以更少样本获得更高圈外提升。
text.en: Frontier tasks should yield more out-of-loop gain per sample.

text.zh: 失败生成课程容易重复旧失败或制造超出当前学习能力的无效难题。
text.en: Failure-generated curricula duplicate old failures or create tasks beyond the useful learning frontier.

text.zh: 先用最小观察/计划/工具/动作替换定位失败模块，再只允许对应模块生成更新。
text.en: Localize the failing module with minimal observation, plan, tool, or action replacements before generating an update.

text.zh: 模块定位正确时，模块专属更新应优于全局反思。
text.en: Correct localization should make module-specific updates outperform global reflection.

text.zh: 整条轨迹反思混合感知、规划、工具和执行错误，生成的经验难以验证。
text.en: Whole-trajectory reflection mixes perception, planning, tool, and execution errors, making lessons hard to verify.

text.zh: 只把可由环境或工具真值裁决的跨架构 Critic 分歧用于更新。
text.en: Use cross-architecture critic disagreement for learning only when environment or tool ground truth can resolve it.

text.zh: 可裁决分歧应比全量 critique 具有更高监督精度。
text.en: Resolvable disagreements should provide higher supervision precision than all critiques.

text.zh: Actor 与同架构 Critic 容易共享盲点，表面一致不能证明正确。
text.en: Actors and same-family critics share blind spots, so agreement is not correctness.

text.zh: 接受纠正前执行最小步骤/观察/工具干预，验证方向一致的因果效应。
text.en: Before accepting a correction, execute a minimal step, observation, or tool intervention and test directional causal consistency.

text.zh: 通过干预验证的纠正应具有更高修复率和迁移性。
text.en: Intervention-validated corrections should repair more reliably and transfer better.

text.zh: Critique 可能只是事后合理化，修复其声称的变量并不会按预期改变答案。
text.en: A critique may be post-hoc rationalization: fixing the claimed variable may not change the answer as predicted.

text.zh: 用世界模型生成受约束的未执行后果，仅在环境规则或模拟器可验证时写入风险记忆。
text.en: Generate constrained unexecuted consequences and admit risk memories only when verified by environment rules or simulators.

text.zh: 验证后的反事实记忆应减少不可逆错误且不导致过度保守。
text.en: Verified counterfactual memory should reduce irreversible errors without excessive conservatism.

text.zh: Agent 只从已执行轨迹学习，难以获得未执行但会导致不可逆损失的负经验。
text.en: Agents learn only from executed trajectories and miss counterfactual negative experience for irreversible actions.

text.zh: 维护更新依赖图，并用分层 disable-replay 估计最小回滚集合。
text.en: Maintain an update dependency graph and estimate a minimal rollback set with hierarchical disable-replay.

text.zh: 局部回滚应比恢复最近 checkpoint 保留更多累积收益。
text.en: Local rollback should preserve more accumulated gain than reverting to the latest checkpoint.

text.zh: 多个更新依次提交后，出现回退时难以确定应撤销哪个祖先更新。
text.en: After multiple commits, regressions do not reveal which ancestor update should be reverted.

text.zh: 用最小反例只收缩适用边界，并保留原规则、例外和修订谱系。
text.en: Use minimal counterexamples to shrink applicability while preserving the original rule, exceptions, and lineage.

text.zh: 局部修复应同时提高反例修复率和旧正例保持率。
text.en: Local repair should improve both counterexample repair and old-positive retention.

text.zh: 一条错误反例会触发整条记忆删除或重写，丢失仍然有效的部分。
text.en: A single counterexample often triggers whole-memory deletion or rewrite, destroying still-valid knowledge.

text.zh: 根据跨任务帮助率、冲突率和漂移证据估计半衰期，触发复验、衰减或删除。
text.en: Estimate half-life from cross-task benefit, conflict, and drift evidence, triggering revalidation, decay, or deletion.

text.zh: 半衰期应比 recency/FIFO 更快删除过期记忆并保留长期有效规则。
text.en: Half-life should remove stale memories faster than recency/FIFO while retaining durable rules.

text.zh: 记忆被永久保留，即使环境、工具或偏好已经变化。
text.en: Memories persist even after environments, tools, or preferences change.

text.zh: 对比终点相同但过程不同的轨迹，只保留跨有效过程稳定的经验。
text.en: Contrast trajectories with identical outcomes but different processes and retain only lessons stable across valid processes.

text.zh: 跨成功过程稳定的经验应比单轨迹反思具有更强圈外迁移。
text.en: Lessons stable across successful processes should transfer better than single-trajectory reflections.

text.zh: 相同终点成功可由可靠过程或偶然捷径产生，结果奖励无法区分两者。
text.en: The same successful endpoint can arise from reliable behavior or accidental shortcuts, which outcome rewards cannot distinguish.

text.zh: 经验准入同时要求终点成功、持续重合和状态残差通过，并按恢复级别控制写入强度。
text.en: Admission requires endpoint success, sustained rejoin, and residual-state checks, with update strength conditioned on recovery level.

text.zh: 完整恢复轨迹应具有更高未来技能复用价值，残差轨迹更易造成负迁移。
text.en: Fully recovered trajectories should have higher future reuse value; residual trajectories should cause more negative transfer.

text.zh: 任务成功或重新加入轨迹不等于完整恢复，残余状态可能被写成成功经验。
text.en: Task success or trajectory rejoin does not imply full recovery, and residual states can be stored as success lessons.

text.zh: 把每次更新视为带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进；仅在隔离回归集通过后 commit，否则 rollback。
text.en: Treat every update as constrained policy improvement; commit only after isolated non-regression, cost, and safety tests, otherwise roll back.

text.zh: 固定预算下，回归门控应提高未来任务收益并显著降低最坏回退率。
text.en: Under fixed budgets, regression gating should improve future-task utility and reduce worst-case regression.

text.zh: Agent 修复当前失败后常直接提交更新，却不检查旧能力和圈外任务是否退化。
text.en: Agents often commit an update after fixing the current failure without checking regressions on mastered and out-of-loop tasks.

text.zh: 对每次检索执行有记忆、打乱记忆、无记忆三臂 matched replay，估计条目级帮助与伤害。
text.en: Run matched replay with retrieved, shuffled, and no memory to estimate entry-level benefit and harm.

text.zh: 隔离识别出的有害条目后，应恢复圈外任务且保留主要收益。
text.en: Quarantining harmful entries should recover out-of-loop tasks without erasing main gains.

text.zh: 记忆提高平均性能，却可能在少数未见任务上强烈误导。
text.en: Memory can improve averages while strongly harming some unseen tasks.

text.zh: 用语义保持、语义改变正对照和捷径探针三类 matched interventions 测选择性不变性。
text.en: Use matched semantics-preserving, semantics-changing positive controls, and shortcut probes to measure selective invariance.

text.zh: 可靠 Reward 应对无关变化稳定、对语义改变敏感，并预测真实选择错误。
text.en: Reliable rewards should be invariant to irrelevant changes, sensitive to semantic changes, and predictive of real selection errors.

text.zh: Reward 对语义无关格式、背景或表述敏感时，Agent 会优化捷径。
text.en: Agents exploit shortcuts when rewards respond to semantically irrelevant format, background, or phrasing.

text.zh: 用正确答案保持、错误答案修复和反事实敏感性三轴定义纠正坍塌。
text.en: Define correction collapse using correct-answer preservation, error repair, and counterfactual sensitivity.

text.zh: 真实纠正应同时提高修复并保持正确答案和无关稳定性。
text.en: Real correction should improve repair while preserving correct answers and irrelevant invariance.

text.zh: 模型可能学会频繁改答案、偏好格式或迎合 Reward，而不是真正纠错。
text.en: A model may learn to change answers, prefer a format, or please a reward without genuinely correcting errors.

text.zh: 让每个派生标签携带来源、置信度和父标签依赖，并把不确定性传播到训练权重。
text.en: Carry provenance, confidence, and parent-label dependencies with each derived label and propagate uncertainty into training weights.

text.zh: 谱系置信应更好预测标签错误并降低噪声放大。
text.en: Lineage confidence should better predict label errors and reduce noise amplification.

text.zh: 多轮自标注和再训练会丢失初始不确定性，低质量标签可能跨代放大。
text.en: Across self-labeling generations, initial uncertainty is lost and low-quality labels can amplify.

text.zh: 根据失败证据学习成本感知路由器，选择最小且最稳定的更新表面。
text.en: Learn a cost-aware router that selects the smallest and most stable update surface from failure evidence.

text.zh: 路由器应以明显低于穷举的成本接近 oracle 修复收益。
text.en: The router should approach oracle repair at substantially lower cost than exhaustive evaluation.

text.zh: 同一失败可通过改 Prompt、记忆、工作流或小模块修复，但系统通常固定更新一种表面。
text.en: The same failure may be fixed by prompt, memory, workflow, or small-module updates, yet systems hard-code one surface.

text.zh: 用轨迹 KL、动作编辑距离、工具路由和记忆检索变化定义离散 Agent 更新信赖域。
text.en: Define a trust region for discrete agent updates using trajectory KL, action-edit distance, tool routing, and memory-retrieval shift.

text.zh: 行为偏移应比文本编辑距离或当前任务收益更好预测回退。
text.en: Behavioral shift should predict regressions better than textual edit distance or current-task gain.

text.zh: 平均收益相似的更新可能引发完全不同的行为分布漂移。
text.en: Updates with similar average gains can induce very different behavioral distribution shifts.

text.zh: 对局部图编辑做 matched ablation，学习节点、边和交互项的结构信用。
text.en: Use matched ablations of local graph edits to learn node, edge, and interaction credit.

text.zh: 结构信用应减少达到同等性能所需的搜索评估，并跨任务复用。
text.en: Structural credit should reduce search evaluations required for the same performance and transfer across tasks.

text.zh: 工作流搜索发现更高分图后，无法知道哪个节点、边或并行结构真正带来改进。
text.en: After workflow search finds a better graph, it is unclear which node, edge, or parallel structure caused the gain.

text.zh: 用结构扰动、任务重命名和工具替换构成最小泛化证书，未通过则不提交。
text.en: Use structural perturbation, task renaming, and tool substitution as a minimal generalization certificate before commit.

text.zh: 通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。
text.en: Certified workflows should transfer better to unseen tools and task graphs.

text.zh: 开发集最优工作流可能利用任务模板，held-out 分数也难覆盖结构捷径。
text.en: Development-optimal workflows may exploit templates, and a single held-out score misses structural shortcuts.

text.zh: 只学习那些预测误差会改变动作选择、风险或恢复决策的转移。
text.en: Learn only transition errors that would change action selection, risk, or recovery decisions.

text.zh: 决策价值门控应以更少更新获得同等或更高任务收益。
text.en: Decision-value gating should match or improve utility with fewer updates.

text.zh: 更准的世界模型不一定改变决策，盲目写入所有转移会增加训练噪声。
text.en: A more accurate world model may not improve decisions, and learning every transition adds noise.

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。

gate.zh: 若“固定预算下，回归门控应提高未来任务收益并显著降低最坏回退率。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Under fixed budgets, regression gating should improve future-task utility and reduce worst-case regression.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
